## Source: amazon-inspector (ecab8a842f7dfacaf3a6294e3dd3c3a1d9c170e1ad119d52f65a94ef431fd262)
Package runpier version 0.1.0 on PyPI was scanned across 10 files. No install-time network activity, no subprocess or exec invocations tied to remote content, no reads of installer secret paths (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, ~/.pypirc), no environment-variable scraping, no persistence mechanisms, and no outbound beacons were observed. No credential material, obfuscated payloads, or lifecycle hooks performing network I/O are present.

## Source: kam193 (ab469bbd671fcc96fad392de06c7652a4f9ea899df3c86d285397bfc3985a690)
This campaign consists of similar loader packages, which provide executing code from a given URL. While they do not contain the malicious payload and the usage remains unknown, they are clearly a coordinated campaign to place multiple deceptive ways to load malicious code.


---
